checkpoint.title: Koga, the SOULBADGE; the GOLD TEETH to the Warden for HM04 STRENGTH; heal at Fuchsia's Center

events.why: the precondition for Koga: the lead at least Lv39, pokeguy's Blastoise here (PokemonSimulation docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md, koga: C2 setup to Sp. Atk +1 and outspeed with X items, from 34/122 HP: 1191/1700 wins, 70.1%, 64.5% to 75.2%); at his level or above, those sims stand for this fight and no new one is needed; below it, the run stops here, before the fight

Koga (TRAINER_LEADER_KOGA): Koffing Lv37, Muk Lv39, Koffing Lv37, Weezing Lv43 (pokeguy: Surf, two on Muk through Minimize, Weezing at 4 HP, 1:16:34 to 1:18:03); then the SOULBADGE and TM06 Toxic, read to the overworld with the battle's text

out of the gym by the way in, Koga's win having beaten every gym trainer (FuchsiaCity_Gym_EventScript_DefeatedKoga, set_gym_trainers 5); east along the city's south row to the Warden's door (33, 31) and up to below the Warden (3, 5) (pokeguy 1:18:04 to 1:18:24)
the Warden (3, 5): the GOLD TEETH from the Safari Zone (11.03)
he takes the GOLD TEETH and gives HM04 STRENGTH (FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_EventScript_GiveGoldTeeth; no YES/NO with the teeth; pokeguy 1:18:25 to 1:18:39)
out of the Warden's door and west along row 32 to below the Center's door (25, 31)
the Center script in: through the door and up to the nurse; no map of the Center
full HP and PP (pokeguy uses a Potion and flies on at 24/126, 1:18:40)

checkpoint: Koga (7, 13), talked to from the west, from the save beside him (12.01): Koffing, Muk, Koffing, Weezing; his NPC medicine is two Hyper Potions and a Full Heal. The lead picks Surf (2x nothing here, the strongest move); pokeguy's Weezing took him to 4/126 HP with Sludge while Koga healed it.
Strength is not taught here: pokeguy teaches it over Water Pulse at Victory Road (19.02, D3).
Ends at Fuchsia's nurse, where 13.01 starts (Fly to Pallet Town, Surf down Route 21).
